evidence.quote: It's your move: call 20, raise 20 or fold.

criteria.why: Every reply uses short, plain table language. None shows JSON, ids or talk about tools.

evidence.quote: You called 20, so the pot is 60 and your bankroll is 970.
You folded, so the dealer takes the 20 pot with J♠ showing.
You bet 50 and the dealer called, so the pot is 120

criteria.why: Each reply acts on the latest check, call, fold, bet or deal click and states what the player can do next.

evidence.quote: You checked and the dealer had already checked, so it goes to a showdown.
Fourth street gives you the J♦ and the dealer the 3♣.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals every street, plays the dealer's actions, reveals the hole cards at showdown and settles the pot itself. The player only chose their own moves and bet sizes.

evidence.quote: You take the 60 pot for a net of +30, and your bankroll is now 1,030.
Each side antes 10, so your bankroll goes from 1,020 to 1,010 and the pot is 20.
so the pot is 120 and your bankroll is 960

criteria.why: Pots, bankrolls and results in each reply match the same turn's surface text and data. They also match the earlier replies, and the 30 net, the 1,030 bankroll and the 120 pot all add up.
